blocks.text: Pelajaran ini tentang menggabungkan dua tindakan: «aku suka menjelajahi tempat baru», «aku berniat tinggal di sini», «aku mau kamu membaca keras-keras», «aku pakai mantel supaya tetap hangat». Tindakan kedua pakai -ing atau to — kata pertama yang menentukan.

examples.en: I enjoy exploring new places.
I intend to stay here.
I want you to read aloud.
I wear a coat to keep warm.
examples.translation: Aku pakai mantel supaya tetap hangat.

blocks.text: Setelah enjoy (suka), finish (selesai), avoid (menghindari), don't mind (tidak keberatan), tindakan kedua diberi -ing: I enjoy exploring new places. Bahasa Indonesia tidak mengubah kata kerja, bahasa Inggris wajib -ing.

examples.en: I enjoy exploring new places.
I must finish writing the summary.
I avoid causing conflict.
I do not mind receiving criticism.
I cannot risk losing my job.
examples.translation: Aku tidak bisa ambil risiko kehilangan pekerjaan.

fixes.wrong: I enjoy to explore new places.
I do not mind receive criticism.
fixes.right: I do not mind receiving criticism.

blocks.text: Setelah want (mau), need (perlu), hope (berharap), plan, intend (berniat), expect, promise, offer, tindakan kedua pakai to dan bentuk kamus: I intend to stay here. Setelah to tanpa -ing dan tanpa -s.

formula.text: want / need / hope / plan / intend / promise

examples.en: I intend to stay here.
I hope to start over.
examples.translation: Aku berharap bisa mulai dari awal.

examples.en: I plan to travel light.
examples.translation: Aku berencana bepergian dengan barang sedikit.

examples.en: I promise to keep you posted.
examples.translation: Aku janji akan terus mengabari kamu.

examples.en: I do not want to lose touch.

blocks.text: «Aku mau kamu membaca» dalam bahasa Inggris perlu to: want / need + orang + to + kata kerja. I want you to read aloud. Bukan your, tapi orangnya: you, him, her.

examples.en: I want you to read aloud.
I need you to straighten the rug.
I want you to tell the truth.
I need you to pay attention.
I want you to wait your turn.

fixes.wrong: I want you approve the plan.
fixes.right: I want you to approve the plan.

fixes.wrong: I want your to approve the plan.
fixes.right: I want you to approve the plan.

fixes.wrong: I want that you read aloud.
fixes.right: I want you to read aloud.

blocks.text: Untuk bilang tujuan — «untuk», «supaya» — bahasa Inggris cukup to + kata kerja: I wear a coat to keep warm. «Untuk» di sini bukan for: for learn itu salah.

formula.text: tujuan: kata kerja seperti di kamus

examples.en: I wear a coat to keep warm.
examples.translation: Aku pakai mantel supaya tetap hangat.

examples.en: I join a study group to learn English.
examples.translation: Aku ikut kelompok belajar untuk belajar bahasa Inggris.

examples.en: I leave early to beat the traffic.
examples.translation: Aku berangkat pagi supaya tidak kena macet.

examples.en: I compare prices to save money.
I take notes to remember the ideas.

fixes.wrong: I join a study group for learn English.
fixes.right: I join a study group to learn English.

fixes.wrong: I join a study group to learning English.
fixes.right: I join a study group to learn English.

drill.question: Di luar dingin. Jelaskan kenapa kamu pakai mantel.
drill.optionA: I wear a coat for keep warm.
drill.optionB: I wear a coat to keep warm.
drill.explain: «Supaya» — to + kata kerja; for tidak dipakai di sini.

sections.title: Kesalahan yang dibuat hampir semua orang

fixes.wrong: I want you approve the plan.
fixes.right: I want you to approve the plan.

fixes.wrong: I join a study group for learn English.
fixes.right: I join a study group to learn English.

fixes.wrong: The no smoking sign means you mustn't to smoke.
fixes.right: The no smoking sign means you mustn't smoke.

blocks.text: -ing atau to — kata pertama yang menentukan. enjoy, finish, avoid, mind — -ing. want, need, hope, plan, promise — to. Hafalkan berpasangan: enjoy exploring, want to stay.
Suka, selesai, menghindari — + -ing. Mau, berharap, berencana — + to. Mau kamu melakukan — want you to. Supaya — to. Setelah to selalu kata kerja seperti di kamus.

examples.en: I enjoy making friends.
I need to check the timetable.
I want to make you laugh.
